title: #stitch with @WICKED the Musical let me quickly make my case about my...
transcript: I know that there are people who are just baffled and bamboozled by the fact that I don't love the Wicked musical and I wanna make a case for myself for a second for not liking the Wicked musical my first real exposure to Wicked was not the musical I knew the musical existed I had seen the Tony Award performance of Defying Gravity but I decided I wanted to read the book before I engage myself in the musical so you can imagine my shock and surprise when the musical was jokes like Head Schiztress and Populer-lar when in the book a little person boinks a tiger and it's described for multiple paragraphs if I remember correctly also described for multiple paragraphs the colour of Elphaba’s certain body parts that's the tone I was expecting out of the Wicked musical not Head Shiztress so I've never really been able to vibe with the musical because of the shock that I received the first time seeing it after reading the book and expecting at least a dance sequence where one of Boq’s buddies fornicated with a tiger perhaps played by a a Julie Taymor like puppet John Choo, you have a chance
